prompt: The French menu and wizard use the same translation file. Changing a line in that file affects every screen that calls the line by its key. The key for “Retry” also appears on a menu button that must keep that wording, but the new wizard asks users to resume where they stopped. The vendor should _____ before adding the new French wording.
promptZh: 法文選單和設定精靈共用同一份翻譯檔。更改檔案中的一行，會影響所有以同一個識別碼呼叫該行的畫面。「重試」的識別碼也用在一個必須保留原字樣的選單按鈕上，但新的設定精靈要請使用者從中斷處繼續。翻譯廠商應先_____，再加入新的法文字樣。

options.text: keep the same key and revise its text
options.zh: 保留相同識別碼並更改字樣
options.whyZh: 共用識別碼會同時改到必須維持原字樣的選單按鈕。

options.text: assign the wizard its own key
options.zh: 為設定精靈另設一個識別碼
options.whyZh: 精靈需要不同字樣；另設識別碼才能更新它，而不改到共用識別碼的選單。

options.text: revise the French menu entry before updating the wizard
options.zh: 先更改法文選單的字樣，再更新設定精靈
options.whyZh: 調整先後順序不能保留選單原字樣，也不會解除識別碼共用。

options.text: make the menu button call the new wizard wording
options.zh: 讓選單按鈕改用設定精靈的新字樣
options.whyZh: 選單按鈕的原字樣不得更改。

explanationZh: 精靈需要不同字樣；另設識別碼才能更新它，而不改到共用識別碼的選單。
evidence: Changing a line in that file affects every screen that calls the line by its key. / a menu button that must keep that wording / the new wizard asks users to resume where they stopped.

vocabulary.note: 可用於先暫停再繼續的流程；並非一定要從頭重做。
